skillsbench-live-server-tasks.name: skillsbench-live-server-tasks
key_points: NEVER bypass external API calls to "speed up" responses — anti-cheat tests assert `elapsed >= Xms`
NEVER remove `performance.mark()` or `data-testid` attributes — explicit constraints, instant failure
DO NOT modify test files — they are read-only oracle files, not editable scaffolding
ALWAYS read test.sh first — it tells you exactly what the verifier runs and where
skillsbench-live-server-tasks.description: SkillsBench tasks that run a live server (Docker + httpx/Playwright tests) — how to read the test harness, fix performance/functionality, and pass host verification.

skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: NEVER assume Docker image contents are staged — the verifier does NOT extract container contents. Output inside a Docker image is invisible to host verification. ALWAYS extract output from Docker to the task directory.
NEVER place outputs inside `tests/` or `environment/` — they're excluded from staging to `/root/`
ALWAYS save deliverables at the task root level — e.g., `task_dir/annotations.json` stages to `<stage>/root/annotations.json`. Also `task_dir/output/...` works.
